tooling_capability.pipeline_language_support: Solidity-only for the deterministic coverage-manifest / gate / lens machinery (build_coverage_manifest.py, tools/static_analysis.py, sandbox_check.py, generate_scope_inventory.py all enumerate only .sol). Cairo is declared in intake SOL_EXTS but NO downstream stage consumes it.
tooling_capability.cairo_status: OUT OF CURRENT AUDIT-WATCH PIPELINE CAPABILITY — not a scope judgment, a tooling limitation. Cairo (.cairo) cannot be ingested into the manifest/gates/lenses without hand-analysis, which the no-mid-run-tuning rule forbids.
tooling_capability.eval_scope_decision: Run the full strict pipeline on the Solidity L1 side only. Score against the COMPLETE answer key but classify families (SOLIDITY_IN_TOOL_SCOPE / MIXED_SOLIDITY_CAIRO / CAIRO_ONLY_OUT_OF_TOOL_SCOPE / NON_CODE_OR_OUT_OF_SCOPE) and report two scorecards.
